items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of boat-dock permit
items.quote: Diese Entscheidung können Sie mit dem Widerspruch angreifen, den Sie binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an den Landkreis Beispiel-Seenplatte, Der Landrat, Seenplattenring 12, 17033 Neu Beispielhagen, richten.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 2025-12-09, sent by ordinary post by an authority in MV. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V (stated in the letter itself) it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Sat 2025-12-13 (this deemed-delivery day does not shift for weekends). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) on Tue 2026-01-13, which is itself a business day so no further shift is needed (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG).

warnings: The letter states no fee is charged for this decision ('Für diesen Bescheid werden keine Kosten erhoben'), yet it still prints the Landkreis's bank IBAN in the footer; this IBAN is not relevant to any payment obligation from this letter and should not be used to send money in response to it.

To meet the deadline with certainty, send the Widerspruch early enough to arrive by 2026-01-13 (e.g. by around 2026-01-07), since the stated date is the day it must reach the Landkreis, not merely be postmarked.
